neighbours.label: the step where something comes out finished after a set time: 'Bake (for N minutes)' in recipes and young 'born' after a gestation
fire: Spoon the mixture into the tin and bake for forty minutes.
Brush the loaves with egg, then bake until golden.
Cover the dish with foil. Bake for about half an hour.
Arrange the biscuits on a tray and bake them for twelve minutes.
Females give birth in spring, with calves born after eleven months.
After a short pregnancy, the pups are born blind in the den.
The foals are usually born at night in late April.
A single chick is born after the parents share the incubation.
quiet: Spoon the mixture into bowls and chill for forty minutes.
Brush the loaves with egg, then slice them thinly.
Cover the salad with a cloth. Serve it after half an hour.
Arrange the biscuits on a plate and serve them with tea.
Females feed in spring, with calves staying close for months.
After a short hunt, the wolves rest quietly in the den.
The foals usually graze at night in late April.
A single chick is fed by both parents for weeks.
